response.justification: Technically the candidate far exceeds the bar: 15+ years of fullstack experience, strong TypeScript/Node.js, React, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and a demonstrated interest in clean architecture and TDD. He is Berlin-based, which fits the high on-site requirement, and his AI-agent/MCP work maps well to the LLM nice-to-haves. The core issue is fit rather than capability: this is an entry-level individual contributor role, and a Staff/Senior engineer with this trajectory is likely to be misaligned on compensation, scope and long-term retention. Relational database depth (PostgreSQL) is also less evident than MongoDB, and there is no Nest.js exposure listed. Worth a screening call only if the team is open to hiring at a higher level or the candidate has explicitly signalled willingness to step into a junior-scoped role.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js, React and fullstack web experience
Berlin-based; strong DevOps/AWS/Kubernetes and LLM-tooling extras
Proven engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, mentoring
concerns: Heavily overqualified for an entry-level posting; likely salary mismatch
PostgreSQL/relational depth unclear (mostly MongoDB); no Nest.js
Retention risk — role scope may not sustain a staff-level engineer

key_factors.factor: Core stack proficiency (TypeScript, React, Node, APIs)
